proposal.reason: Primary change is in network behavior: proxy progress batching/shutdown handling in proxy.cc and larger built-in NET request capacity via NCCL/PCCL_NET_MAX_REQUESTS. Added device-topology logic (ncclTopoCheckNet, PATH_NET, topology path updates) introduces bandwidth/affinity-based intra-node NET reachability policy, and transport has independent selection changes in net/p2p/shm canConnect paths to apply that policy when choosing intra-node communication routes.
